meta.name: document-gen-resilient-workflow
meta.description: Multi-engine document generation with cascading PDF fallbacks and robust Unicode handling

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多引擎生成文档，自动降级处理PDF异常
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要稳定生成含Unicode的PDF文档
copy.tagline_en: Generate documents with multi-engine fallback for robust PDF output
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need reliable PDF generation with Unicode support

howto.what: 当文档生成任务失败时，Claude会启动多引擎回退工作流：先创建Markdown源文件，再清理特殊Unicode字符，然后依次尝试pdflatex、xelatex、wkhtmltopdf、reportlab、fpdf2等引擎生成PDF，并转换为DOCX和HTML，最后验证文件有效。
howto.when: 当文档生成失败、shell_agent返回未知错误，或遇到PDF生成工具缺失、编码错误等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我生成一份含特殊符号的合同，输出PDF和DOCX。
say.note: Claude会使用多引擎回退确保成功。

say.text: PDF生成失败了，请尝试其他引擎。

howto.what_en: When document generation fails, Claude initiates a multi-engine fallback workflow: creates Markdown source, sanitizes Unicode special characters, then sequentially tries pdflatex, xelatex, wkhtmltopdf, reportlab, and fpdf2 for PDF, and also generates DOCX and HTML, finally verifying file validity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when document generation tasks fail, shell_agent returns unknown errors, or when PDF generation tools are missing or encoding issues occur.

say_en.text: Generate a contract with special symbols and output PDF and DOCX.
say_en.note: Claude uses multi-engine fallback to ensure success.

say_en.text: PDF generation failed, please try other engines.
say_en.note: Will try xelatex, wkhtmltopdf, etc. in sequence.

say_en.text: Convert this Markdown to PDF and HTML.
